description: This file defines an enum called PasswordStrength, representing different levels of password robustness such as WEAK, FAIR, GOOD, STRONG, and VERY_STRONG. It includes properties for the string description and numeric strength, methods to retrieve these properties, and a static method to map an integer to a PasswordStrength value with validation.

classes.name: PasswordStrength
classes.description: Enum class representing various password strength levels with associated string labels and numeric values, including utility methods for conversion and validation.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string description of the password strength level.

methods.name: getStrengthNum
methods.description: Returns the numeric representation of the password strength.

methods.name: fromValue
methods.description: Converts an integer to the corresponding PasswordStrength enum, throwing an exception if the value is out of range.
